mapper.insert: INSERT INTO import_part (record_id, part_number, etag, part_size, create_time) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{partNumber}, #{etag}, #{partSize}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE etag = VALUES(etag), part_size = VALUES(part_size)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM import_part WHERE record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY part_number
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM import_part WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(part_size), 0) FROM import_part WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
